content.short: Mutuum Finance is a decentralized, non-custodial lending and borrowing protocol on Aptos.
content.description: Mutuum Finance is a sophisticated liquidity protocol on the Aptos blockchain that employs a hybrid lending model. It combines Peer-to-Contract (P2C) mechanics for highly liquid assets like stablecoins with Peer-to-Peer (P2P) functionality for more volatile or niche tokens. This architecture ensures optimal capital efficiency and deep liquidity across a wide range of asset classes, providing users with a secure and flexible platform for decentralized finance. The protocol aims to revolutionize on-chain credit by offering tailored interest rate models and robust risk management for every user.
